summary.text: Helen Hunter is a Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 10 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026.
She has run for the Arizona House in each election since 2020 and lost each time.

paragraphs.text: Helen Hunter ran for Arizona House of Representatives District 16 in the 2020 general election, losing to Jacqueline Parker and incumbent John Fillmore.
She then ran in District 10, finishing behind Justin Heap and Barbara Parker in the 2022 general election and behind Justin Olson and Ralph Heap in 2024.
